lines.text: The valley was full of bones, and lo, they were very dry.
Nobody was praying over them anymore. God asked one question instead.
Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones: I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.
The fear didn't leave the valley. The prophet just kept speaking until breath came.
So breath came into them, and they stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
Whatever looks dead in your life is not past His breath. Speak to it until it stands. In Jesus' name, amen.

bold: Speak to it until it stands
title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: These Bones Shall Live
story: A three-scene illustrated short film visualizing Ezekiel 37's valley of dry bones: sun-bleached bones scattered across an ash-grey valley floor, a lone prophet lifting his hands as teal breath breaks through the grey, and the bones standing up as a great army under a gold-blue dawn.
